items.briefing:
Two vulnerabilities are getting attention today. A flaw in Zimbra email software is actively being exploited in the wild, and patches need to be applied quickly — security teams are warning the window to act is narrowing fast. Separately, publicly available exploit code has been released targeting weaknesses in Cudy routers, meaning attackers can now take advantage of these devices with minimal effort. If your organisation uses either of these products, check with your IT support today.

Google Cloud is also reminding organisations that strong cyber basics — things like multi-factor authentication and prompt patching — remain the most effective defence even as AI-powered attacks increase.

**Tip:** If you're unsure whether your organisation's software and devices are up to date, raise it with your IT team today — don't wait for a scheduled review.

featured.title: Exploited Zimbra Flaw Highlights Shrinking Window to Patch
